item.title: Embedding a Meshery Design in a WordPress Post
item.description:
In this tutorial, you embed an interactive Meshery Design in a WordPress post. The embed export comes from Kanvas, so you need access to Kanvas, and a design to embed. If you don’t have a design, use one of the public designs in Kanvas.

  1. In Kanvas, expand the Designs panel on the left.

  2. Click the Quick actions button (the vertical ellipsis) next to the design, and select Export Design.

  3. In the list of formats, click the download icon next to Embed Design.
